email.title: Connect with email
email.description: Enter the email and password of your Qubo account (the same one used in the Qubo mobile app).

phone.title: Connect with phone number
phone.description:
Enter the phone number linked to your Qubo account. You'll receive an SMS code to verify it.

Note: this requires an email address on your Qubo account's profile (not necessarily one you log in with) - the integration uses it behind the scenes to get a long-lived session, just like email login.

phone_otp.title: Enter the SMS code
phone_otp.description: Enter the one-time code sent to your phone.

phone_select_profile.title: Select account
phone_select_profile.description: Multiple Qubo accounts are linked to this phone number. Choose which one to connect.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Qubo cloud service
error.invalid_auth: Invalid email, password, or OTP code
error.rate_limited: Qubo's cloud is temporarily rate-limiting login attempts ("Login Limit reached"). Wait a few minutes before trying again.

abort.already_configured: This Qubo account is already configured
